findings.summary: Boxercraft is the only tested brand site with public flannel-pant catalog matches; observed Boxercraft flannel pants range $26.85-$42.85.
For broader pants/joggers/sweatpants, Boxercraft is $26.85-$58.85; L2 Brands is $29.99-$79.95; Colosseum is $15.00-$55.00.
Colosseum exposes more UCLA/Bruins public catalog matches than Boxercraft in the tested direct-site feeds (20 vs 6).
L2 Brands search returns relevant matches more often than autocomplete in the tested query set (3/8 search vs 0/8 autocomplete).
Concepts Sport is relevant as a licensed lounge/sleepwear competitor, but the public Wix catalog did not expose comparable prices or product-grid titles through this automated run.
